title: G7: Grant the disposable three-Action rehearsal (12h; accepts Decision 0058 for PR readiness and reviews, #925; never GitHub merge)
problem: OPERATOR ACKNOWLEDGEMENT REQUIRED BEFORE PRESSING (open question https://github.com/pmark/arcadia/issues/925): the production tick pushes the settled head, marks the host-created PR ready and spends reviewer-model tokens only when the policy carries BOTH --remote-preservation AND a current Decision 0058 integration grant naming the Action, and whether Decision 0058 covers those three effects is not settled. Pressing this Grant records that you accept Decision 0058 for that use, for these three disposable fixture Actions only and until the 12-hour expiry; if you do not, do not press and ask for a separate grant option instead. The installed three-Action rehearsal needs one bounded live authorization: the production tick must preserve each fixture Action to a draft PR, ready it, run both independent reviews and integrate by local fast-forward with no operator step. A generic activation would be too broad, and a stale preview, release or preflight must not be activated.
desired_effect: Pressing accepts Decision 0058 for these three fixture Actions only (#925): readying the PR, pushing the settled head and reviewer-model spend, until the 12-hour expiry. Read 'What this action does' first. After fail-closed preconditions, a passing G6 receipt no older than 30 minutes bound to the same main, installed release, workspace, fixture and policy revision, and a passing host replay of tests/rehearsal-three-action.test.ts (all three variants including the tick-driven review variant, five-minute bound), recheck main, release, fixture, leases and policy, preview at the current policy revision, preview again immediately before activation requiring the identical fingerprint and revision, activate once with that expected revision, then verify the activated fingerprint equals the preview and turn this Grant Off on any mismatch: Project three-action-rehearsal, Plan autonomous-three-action-rehearsal, Actions write-start-marker, transform-start-marker and verify-final-rehearsal in order, provider claude-code-cli, concurrency one, transitions validation, acceptance, pointer and packet_approval with a 12-hour packet-approval expiry, --remote-preservation, and a 12-hour Decision 0058 integration grant naming each of the three Actions.

does: Requires the #925 acknowledgement stated at the start of the problem: pressing accepts Decision 0058 for pushing the settled head, readying the PR and reviewer spend for these three fixture Actions only, until expiry
Runs only when launched from /runs (exact id and descriptor) outside any agent sandbox

Requires main clean, level with last-fetched origin/main and with a fresh 30-second git ls-remote of origin main, containing #922 and #924, Decision 0058 approved, an installed broker release that is ready and runtime-identical to main, and fresh host transports

Requires the G1 fixture clean at its single genesis commit with the exact manifest and origin, production Inactive with zero live admissions, and the latest G6 receipt succeeded, at most 30 minutes old and bound to the same main, release, workspace, fixture and policy revision

Runs the hermetic three-Action rehearsal on the host before any preview; failure, timeout, a missing tick variant or an agent sandbox prevents activation; afterwards it rechecks main, the installed release, the fixture, fixture leases and the policy revision before previewing

Previews at the current policy revision, previews again immediately before activation and requires the identical fingerprint and revision, activates once with request id grant-production-three-action-rehearsal-2026-10-04 and --expected-revision, then verifies the activated fingerprint; activate itself recomputes scope from the queue and takes no fingerprint, so a mismatch is detected afterwards and returns this Grant to Off

Permits only the reviewed scope and draft-PR remote preservation, and, if Decision 0058 is accepted for this use (#925), pushing the settled head, readying the host-created PR and running arcadia qa code-review and arcadia qa pr before local fast-forward integration, which the tick does only while the policy carries both --remote-preservation and the Decision 0058 grant naming the Action

After any activation attempt that does not verify (including a failed, timed-out or unparsable activate, or SIGTERM/SIGINT), reads production status back, returns only its own Grant to Off if it is Active, and records the observed state (or UNKNOWN, telling you to run G8 now) in a timestamped receipt and failure handoff. SIGKILL or a host crash cannot be handled by any trap; if the run vanishes after activation, run G8 (restore-terminal-off-three-action-rehearsal-2026-10-04), which turns off exactly this Grant's policy
never_does: Never authorizes a GitHub merge or a push to any base branch; integration is the local fast-forward and origin main never moves
Never grants another Project, Plan, Action, provider, transition or a concurrency above one, and never lifts the concurrency gate
Never launches, terminates or resumes a Session, restarts a service, or reactivates production after Off

Never activates twice under its request id: it refuses when the current policy already carries this request id, and a later rerun with the same id cannot add an activation (the activate command replays the recorded receipt for the same scope or refuses a different scope with 'Use a new request id'); the one-shot button stays disabled after success
Never changes credentials, branch protection, repository settings or any Decision

success.effect: One scoped, expiring policy is Active whose recorded fingerprint equals both previews; the receipt names the only admitted Actions, the expiry, the installed release and the G6 receipt it relied on.
success.next: Observe the tick admit write-start-marker, then each dependent Action in turn, through production status and the dashboard. When the rehearsal ends or anything looks wrong, run G8 (restore-terminal-off-three-action-rehearsal-2026-10-04).

failure.effect: If no activation was attempted, policy is unchanged. After an attempt, the script reads production status back, returns only its own Grant to Off when it is Active, and records the observed result (not_active, returned_off, other_grant_active, OFF_FAILED or UNKNOWN).
failure.next: Do not press again blindly. Read the handoff; if it says OFF_FAILED or UNKNOWN, run G8 now. Otherwise resolve the named drift, rerun G6 and request a fresh G7.
